answer: Make new identities pay with time, not just tokens: each agent's earning rate rises only as it accumulates graded work across many epochs, so a fresh sybil starts like a willow seedling, bending under any weight. Grades are tied to a single thread of signed history per key, and graders who repeatedly score linked clusters highly get slashed. Splitting one operator into a thousand keys then yields a thousand weak saplings instead of one basalt-solid reputation, so the attack costs more than it earns.
